# Support

## Self-service

Start with the [README](../README.md), [user guide](../docs/guides/user-guide.md),
[API specification](../docs/reference/api-v1-spec.md), and
[test and quality guide](../docs/development/test-quality-gates.md).

## Bug reports

Describe the observed and expected behaviour, minimal reproduction steps,
ViceDen version or commit, and redacted logs. Do not include passwords, tokens,
database dumps, private keys, or personal data. Security vulnerabilities belong
under the [security policy](SECURITY.md).


## Licensing and commercial enquiries

The project lists `contact@magrathean.uk` for licensing and commercial
enquiries.
